newsitem.title: USA: Orion files for $322 mln notes, warrants.
newsitem.headline: Orion files for $322 mln notes, warrants.

text.p: Orion Network Systems Inc said Thursday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $322 million in units of senior notes and warrants and senior discount notes and warrants.
Orion will sell up $222 million worth of units consisting of a senior note due 2007 and a warrant to buy common stock. The notes and warrants will be offered only in units.

The company will sell up to $100 million worth of units consisting of a senior discount note due 2007 and a warrant to buy common stock. The senior discount notes and warrants will be offered only units.

A majority of the proceeds will be applied to repay the Orion 1 Credit Facility, and the remainder will be used to repay certain debt and other obligations of the company for working capital and general corporate purposes.

Orion, of Rockville, Md., is a provider of satellite-based communications services, focused primarily on private communications networks, internet services and video distribution and other satellite transmission services.
